code:
use default

factorial(value: int) -> bigint is
    let product mut = 1n

    for factor in 2::value do
        product = product * bigint(factor)
    od

    product
si

lah(n: int, k: int) -> bigint =>
    if k == 1 then factorial(n)
    elif k == n then 1n
    elif k > n \/ k < 1 \/ n < 1 then 0n
    else factorial(n) * factorial(n - 1) /
         (factorial(k) * factorial(k - 1)) / factorial(n - k)
    fi

write_line("unsigned Lah numbers, L(n, k):")
write_line("")

let heading = LIST()
heading.add("{"n/k",3}")

for k in 1::12 do
    heading.add("{k,12}")
od

write_line(heading |> join(""))

for n in 1::12 do
    let row = LIST()
    row.add("{n,3}")

    for k in 1::n do
        row.add("{lah(n, k),12}")
    od

    write_line(row |> join(""))
od

let largest =
    (1::100) |> map(k => lah(100, k))
            |> reduce(0n,
                      (best, v) => if v > best then v else best fi)

write_line("")
write_line("the largest L(100, k):")
write_line("  {largest}")
